modules.name: Galaxy XR Fan Control
modules.about: Overrides the system fan speed, with WebUI steps or a temperature-based curve.

modules.name: Galaxy XR No Low-Light Toast
modules.about: Disables the ambient-light pipeline so the low-light popup never appears.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Passthrough Anywhere
modules.about: Toggles passthrough in any XR app with a double-tap, without minimizing.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Camera Debug WebStream
modules.about: Streams all 13 headset cameras as MJPEG on port 8080 at native sensor rates.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Mic Gain Boost
modules.about: +15 dB mic gain while Virtual Desktop records; event-driven, no polling.
